paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw nangmah ah ka ginna ka nga a; hon delh tengteng lak ah hon hondam in hon humbit in;
heading: David La, Benjamin Mi Kush Ziak A / Dikna Ngen A Thumna
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

paite: huchi lou in zaw, humbitpa om lou in humpinelkai bang in, ka hinna abotnen kha ding hi.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, huchibang a hih ka na hih a, ka khut a khelhna a-om a,
english: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

paite: ka lawm khelhna a thuk ka na hihleh, ahi, bangmah lou a hon dou ka humbit ana hi zaw.
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

paite: Melma in ka hinna delh in, delhpha mai hen aw; ahi, ka hinna lei ah chilpuk in, ka thupina leivui lak ah koih mai hen. Selah
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh in thou inla, hon doute thangpaihna dou ding in kisa inla; kei a ding in kihihhalh inla; vaihawmna ding thu na peta hi.
english: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

paite: Huchi in michih omkhawmte'n hon umsuak uhen, huan, nang atung uah sangpi in kik nawn in.
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

paite: TOUPA'N michih vai ahawmsak hi. TOUPA aw, keimah a ka diktatna leh ka lungsim hoihna om bang zel in vai hon hawmsak in.
english: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

paite: Giloute gitlouhna hong tawp taleh aw, midiktatte hihkip in. Pathian diktat in lungtangte leh lungsimte a-enchian hi.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

paite: Pathian kiang ah ka phaw a-om, amah zaw lungtang dikpu hondampa ahi.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

paite: Pathian vaihawmpa diktat ahi, ahi, niteng in migiloute tung a lung hihlouhna nei Pathian ahi.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

paite: Mi akiheikik keileh ama'n anamsau tat-hiam in; thalpeu alai a, amanta hi.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

paite: Sihna vanzatte amah thahna ding in leng abawl dimdiam a; athalte kuangthei in abawl hi.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

paite: En in, gitlouhna in thulimlouhna apiangsak a; ahi, thilhihkhelhna apai a, zuauthu apiangsakta hi.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

paite: Kokhuk abawl a, thukpi in atou a, amah khuk toh ah aketa hi.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

paite: Athilhihkhelhna ama lutung mah ah ahong kik nawn ding, hiamgamtak a athilhih ama sip mah ah ake ding hi.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

paite: TOUPA adiktatna ziak in, akiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding; TOUPA tungnungpen min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
